information_contract.signal: Frozen DF006 D1; later declared dividend amount/payment/correction never enters decisions
information_contract.retrospective: Separate evidence-backed total-return ledger; later acquired facts labeled ex-post, not historical signal knowledge
information_contract.cash: Receivable distinct from spendable cash; no cash before verified payment date and evidence of payment
information_contract.tax: Investor-specific actual tax unknown => TAX_TREATMENT_PENDING and actual net total return NULL; labeled research scenarios do not verify tax
information_contract.basis: RAW only for price-plus-cash accounting; reject adjusted-plus-dividend double counting
information_contract.immutability: No modification to old Ledger, D1 engine, prior results or rejected preliminary 131290 diagnostics

promotion: Only evidence-complete bounded V2 replay; unknown material actions/rights/settlement => HOLD. Positive PnL is never promotion criterion. Full research eligibility stays separate.

event_controls.treatment: Direct buyback decision, first eligible post-publication session, frozen D1 targets/exit/costs
event_controls.candidate_universe: PIT eligible same-market securities; no present-day survivor replacement
event_controls.cutoff: All matching features available strictly before decision; observation and acquisition evidence required
features: log trailing20 observed-session median KRW turnover
event_controls.selection: Same market; no event exposure; pre-feature standardized Euclidean distance using cross-sectional pre-treatment median/MAD (zero MAD drops feature); nearest three, deterministic receipt+standard-code hash tie-break. No match => unmatched, never replace after outcomes.
event_controls.non_event: Complete relevant disclosure census in preregistered exclusion window [-30,+5 calendar days]; future event classification is an ex-post contamination audit, never a signal; no complete census => UNKNOWN and not admissible
event_controls.industry: Only if contemporaneous PIT industry evidence exists; otherwise NULL, no current-sector proxy
event_controls.capital_cost_risk: Same capital, calendar holding, execution capacity, fees/tax/slippage, expense and risk constraints; report exposure differences, no post-hoc scaling
event_controls.interpretation: Matched observational association; no strict causal claim when confounding remains
event_controls.statistics: No tests below frozen DF006 minimum 30 events, 10 firms, 20 entry dates, 5 declining-market events and 80% admissible matched controls; account for firm/date/market dependence and multiplicity
event_controls.falsification: Nonpositive net incremental return versus preselected controls or no positive STRESS increment fails support; no threshold/selection relaxation after results
event_controls.execution: DESIGN_ONLY; not a new optimization trial

risk: Preserve DF010 actual weights, residuals and unfulfilled reductions; central risk not executed, 25% target is not LIVE approval
